name: kinovi_generate
description: Generate video on Kinovi (Seedance and Wan models, one key). Mode follows the inputs: text only, --image (first frame, optional --end-image), or --ref-image/--ref-video/--ref-audio (Seedance reference mode). Local files are uploaded to Kinovi first. Standalone.

output.description: Path to the generated video (.mp4). With --json: {path, taskId, model, creditsUsed, draft}.

params.name: out
params.description: Output .mp4 path. Optional with _project: saved in the project's assets folder.

params.name: model
params.description: seedance2-5 is the default. seedance2-fast and seedance2.0-mini are cheaper (480p/720p); wan3.0-text-to-video and wan3.0-image-to-video refuse real people's faces.

params.name: ref-image
params.description: Reference image (repeatable; Seedance). Mutually exclusive with --image.

params.name: ref-video
params.description: Reference video (repeatable; Seedance; billed at the reference-video rate).

params.name: ref-audio
params.description: Reference audio (repeatable; Seedance; needs an image or video beside it).

params.name: duration
params.description: Seconds: seedance2-5 4-30, the other Seedance models 4-15, Wan 2-30.

params.name: aspect-ratio
params.description: 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:3, 3:4 (Seedance also 21:9). Frames follow the first frame's ratio.

params.name: resolution
params.description: Model-dependent: 4k is seedance-20 only; seedance2-fast and seedance2.0-mini stop at 720p.

params.name: sound
params.description: Generate audio with the clip. Off by default.

params.name: draft
params.description: seedance2-5 at 480p only: a cheap preview that --upgrade turns into 1080p within 7 days.

params.name: upgrade
params.description: A seedance2-5 draft's task id: generate it again at 1080p (billed as 1080p).

params.name: task-id
params.description: A task already submitted (a run that timed out): wait for it and download it. No new task, no new charge.
